shop/tables

What it is
  Give a project the tables its work is kept in.
  What it is doing is written down as it goes, so that it is taken up where it was after a restart.
  Whoever applies it may tell it 3 things:
    - extra: The table a project names for itself. It has to be said.
    - shape: What that table is made of. It has to be said.
    - kind: What kind its size is. Unless it is said: `number`.

What it makes
  A table called `people`. [people]
    | `born`: date.
    | `count`: number.
    | `holds`: list. Whoever writes a row holds each scope it then says. Where nothing is said: `things`.
    | `how`: choice of `look`, `change` or `run`. Giving it `run` takes `shell`.
    | `lead`: record of `people`.
    | `level`: choice of `low` or `high`. Where nothing is said: `low`.
    | `ready`: flag.
    | `role`: text. Usually `maker` or `keeper`.
    | `secret`: text. Giving it a value takes `shell` and `secrets:use`.
    | `size`: what the param `kind` says.
    | `tags`: list.
    | `title`: text. A row cannot be without it.
    | `works`: records of `jobs`.
  A table called `jobs`. [jobs]
    | `worker`: record of `people`. Giving it a value takes `things:write`.
    | It sits beside `people`, and each of its rows is about what its `worker` says of that.
    | Its rows are not written by hand: what keeps it writes them.
  A table called what the param `extra` says. [own]
    | What it is made of is what the param `shape` says.

What it does when it is applied
  1. Make sure a table is there, made as it says. [people]
  2. Make sure a table is there, made as it says. [jobs]
  3. Make sure a table is there, made as it says. [own]

What it may do
  It runs as whoever applies it, and can do no more than they can.
  Make and change things. [things:write]
